description: Which official CrossInk commit each FrotzX3 release is built against. Newest first, except that entries marked opt_in_only are never chosen by default. Only mark an entry tested (and drop opt_in_only) after regression and XTEINK X3 hardware testing; a clean patch or a successful compile is not enough.

releases.firmware_hardware_test_result: PASSED on XTEINK X3 (cleaned final build, no regressions): cold boot, Home, EPUB Reader, Settings, File Browser, Frotz picker, Lost Pig, Zork, Varicella, save/load, rewind, exit/re-entry, sleep/wake, Select/Power behaviour, Home cover redraw after exiting Frotz
releases.firmware_hardware_test_history: First hwtest (SHA-256 913dcdd4...) FAILED on large stories. Root cause: Home's ~16 KB cover cache sometimes spilled into retention RAM, starving Lost Pig's 42,554 B contiguous block (the 16,384 B C3 render stack was a second consumer of that region). Permanent fix: release the cover before pushing FrotzX3 (invalidateCoverCache() under RenderLock), C3 render stack 16,384 -> 12,288 B, failure-screen reason drawn below the title. Measured on X3: Lost Pig allocator headroom about 19 KB over the rounded block (retention free block ~62,364 B; largest allocatable block ~61,428 B before the allocation), lowest render-task stack HWM 5,048 B remaining with the 12 KiB stack (peak use ~7,240 B). The diagnostics-free final build (SHA-256 1e63d288...) then passed the full hardware checklist.
releases.memory_guardrail: Hardware-validated PASS on XTEINK X3: normal startup (Lost Pig, Zork, Varicella) PASS; forced-failure path PASS (clean refusal before allocation, FROTZ START FAILED shows "Not enough contiguous memory for this story."). Runtime margin 1,024 B; hardware-validated story requirement floor 42,554 B; theoretical Z-machine maximum 65,534 B; v1.6.1 does not guarantee every near-64K story. Future CrossInk releases must repeat the contiguous-memory validation (tools/installer/MEMORY_BUDGET.md) before being marked supported.
releases.notes: Hardware-validated on XTEINK X3 for CrossInk v1.6.1 (commit 9914146e) only; see tools/installer/PORTING_TO_CROSSINK_1.6.1.md. Firmware produced by the patch installer has not itself been flashed; a reconstructed build was verified to carry the same source tree as the validated image. Future CrossInk releases require their own explicit hardware validation before being marked supported; this result does not carry over to any other version.
